Name: Green Bay Packers (NFL)
Description:
Green Bay Packers rings and other merchandise.

Founded in 1919 and based in Green Bay, Wisconsin, the Green Bay Packers are one of the NFL’s most storied franchises, with 4 Super Bowl titles and a league-record 13 total championships. Their 1962 team went 13-1, and legends like Bart Starr (SB I & II MVP), Brett Favre, and Aaron Rodgers (4× MVP) defined eras of dominance. After a 29-year Super Bowl drought, they returned to glory in Super Bowl XLV (2010 season). In 2023, they made the playoffs again with rising QB Jordan Love—proof that Titletown’s legacy is far from finished.
